test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A, N, E,H and S are sitting on a bench facing north. A is sitting to the immediate right of S and S is at one of the corners. E is sitting to the right of H, and to the left of N. Who is sitting to the immediate left of H?
solution:
As per the given information, the sitting arrangement is:

1. A is sitting to the immediate right of S and S is at one of the corners.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ec92833a0c4f34a4429ef47f7523dc55840ae16f3455f3ff124cc76051bd738.png] 

2. E is sitting to the right of H, and to the left of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8224e4b1967b9426476ea5aed0d1c7c9c9f589b93ec83d6e70160be7b9d999d3.png] 

Here,** 'A' **is sitting to the immediate left of H.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
